title: Black hole singularity is a surface not a point
summary: A theoretical physics paper proposing that black hole singularities are not infinitely dense points as traditional general relativity predicts, but rather 2D surfaces, potentially resolving the infinities that plague singularity predictions in modern physics.
problem_solved: Addresses the fundamental problem of singularities in black holes where general relativity predicts infinite density and breaks down.
why_valuable: Could provide a pathway toward resolving the conflict between general relativity and quantum mechanics, potentially contributing to a unified theory of quantum gravity.
